Description: Specifies the complete feeds available for use in ration formulation, including each feed’s cost, as well as purchasing cycle allowances and buffer
Unique identifier for a feed in standard or user feed library
Fractional number 0 to 1 used as a cushion for feed purchases to help plan for herd fluctuations and feed shrink
Upper limit of purchased feed masses and/or money that can be spent on this feed on a single day (kg or $)
Upper limit of purchased feed masses and/or money that can be spent on this feed at the beginning of a ration interval (kg or $)
Upper limit of purchased feed masses and/or money that can be spent on this feed at the beginning of a new planning cycle (kg or $)
allowable amount of milk reduction (kg) when dietary nutrient supply cannot meet animal requirements
The maximum number of feed recalculations that can be performed per year

Allowable +/- fractional deviation applied to each user-defined ration inclusion percentage (a single value applies to all feeds and animal combinations). E.g., a feed with a user-defined ration percentage of 20% DM and a tolerance of 0.1 would have an allowable range of 18% to 22% DM

Inputs for DMI and ration composition for each animal combination. Exactly one array must be provided for each animal combination. When auto-formulation option is used, ration_percentage, intake_option, and intake_value inputs here are ignored.
Animal combination a given ration corresponds to
Dry matter intake option used for this animal combination's ration. Options: predict_DMI, set_DMI, or set_DMI_per_X (set_DMI_per_X is available only for lactating and growing combinations)

Dry matter intake value used for the ration of this animal combination. Units are kg/animal/day for set_DMI, and kg dry matter intake per kg milk yield (lac_cow) or per kg average daily gain (growing) for set_DMI_per_X. Required when intake_option is set_DMI or set_DMI_per_X; ignored when intake_option is predict_DMI
Array of feeds available to the specified animal combination (one array per feed used in the ration)
Unique identifier for a feed in standard or user feed library
Ration inclusion percentage (%DM) for this feed; utilized only in user-defined ration option
